name: Magnetic Pendulum Basins
desc: A magnetic-pendulum basin fractal where every pixel releases a damped pendulum tugged by a slowly rotating ring of magnets and is coloured by which magnet captures it, so vivid attractor pools churn along infinitely filigreed boundaries — also rendered as molten settle-time thermal, soft pastel, glowing boundary-only neon, or four-tone hatched ink.

scale.doc: view zoom into the basin field (higher = deeper boundary filigree)

chaos.doc: filigree turbulence — lower friction + sharper wells = more chaotic boundaries

hue.doc: palette base hue (basins spread around from here)
